<title level="1" right="Creature Family">[Dragon, Fortune](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=400)</title>

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 116

Fortune dragons have the innate ability to draw upon the raw magical energies that surround them. They constantly use these magical energies to empower their magical abilities and even their bodies, as the energy can heal wounds. A fortune dragon has a typical build for an arcane dragon, but their bodies sport a striking feature: their treasure. The dragon's nature of drawing upon magic causes coins, gems, and, most notably, magical items to cling to their body like iron drawn to magnets. A dragon constantly pulls magical energies from the items attached to their body and makes use of these energies to cast spells. The magical energies that flow through a fortune dragon constantly flow through the dragon's items as well, and in many cases, the items melt from the heat produced in this process. Fortune dragons are seekers of novel experiences. This desire for originality leads fortune dragons to approach visitors of other ancestries with curiosity, though this initial interest quickly wanes if a visitor lacks exciting qualities.

<title level="2">Members</title>
[Adult Fortune Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2945) (Creature 14), [Ancient Fortune Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2946) (Creature 19), [Young Fortune Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2944) (Creature 10)

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar_3_Locations.png">Fortune Dragon Lairs</title>

A fortune dragon's lair typically holds a much larger hoard than other dragons collect. These hoards are full of relatively worthless relics, objects, and armaments drained of all of their magical energy, and finding useful treasures among them requires a lot of effort. Fortune dragons are particularly protective of their rarest treasures and will either bury them deep within their hoard or keep them directly attached to their bodies, where the treasure is safest. A fortune dragon will unleash their full fury to protect their hoard from any outsiders, regardless of the person's standing.
</aside>

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="">Fortune Dragon Spellcasters</title>

Fortune dragon spellcasters tend to cast the following spells. 

### Young Fortune Dragon
 **Arcane Prepared Spells** DC 30, attack +22; **4th** [_flicker_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1532), [_translocate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1724), [_vision of death_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1742); **3rd** [_aqueous orb_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1443), [_grease_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1547), [_haste_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1553); **2nd** [_invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1577), [_mist_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1606), [_web_](/Spells.aspx?ID=374); **1st** [_gust of wind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1550), [_item facade_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1579), [_phantasmal minion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1631); **Cantrips (4th)** [_electric arc_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1509), [_figment_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1528), [_prestidigitation_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1639), [_shield_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1671), [_telekinetic hand_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1715) 

### Adult Fortune Dragon
 **Arcane Prepared Spells** DC 36, attack +28; As young fortune dragon, plus **6th** [_cursed metamorphosis_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1479), [_teleport_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1720), [_wall of force_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1749); **5th** [_howling blizzard_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1559), [_scouting eye_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1661), [_toxic cloud_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1722); **Cantrips (6th)** _electric arc_, _figment_, _prestidigitation_, _shield_, _telekinetic hand_ 

### Ancient Fortune Dragon
 **Arcane Prepared Spells** DC 45, attack +37; As adult fortune dragon, plus **9th** [_detonate magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1488), [_falling stars_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1521), [_phantasmagoria_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1629); **8th** [_arctic rift_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1444), [_disappearance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1490), [_uncontrollable dance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1730); **7th** [_contingency_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1472), [_energy aegis_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1512), [_planar palace_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1634); **Cantrips (9th)** _electric arc_, _figment_, _prestidigitation_, _shield_, _telekinetic hand_
</aside>

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar_4_RelatedCreatures.png">Lethiliss</title>

Initially drawn to the Calphiuak Mountains of New Thassilon in northwestern Avistan by the magical power of ancient runelords, the fortune dragon Lethiliss spent several decades gathering magical artifacts. During Earthfall, one of these artifacts activated, locking Lethiliss in a magical stasis that only broke millennia later. They now spend much of their time traveling the region to track down magical relics for their collection and to learn more about the modern world.
</aside>

<title level="2" right="Creature Family Group">Dragon</title>

**Related Families**
[Dragon, Adamantine](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=396), [Dragon, Conspirator](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=397), [Dragon, Diabolic](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=398), [Dragon, Empyreal](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=399), [Dragon, Horned](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=401), [Dragon, Mirage](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=402), [Dragon, Omen](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=403)
